description: This file defines a class 'AzureTableStorageRemindersProviderBuilder' that implements the 'IProviderBuilder' interface for configuring Azure Table Storage reminders in an Orleans silo. It contains logic to set up the reminder service with options for table name, service key, and connection string, based on configuration.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageRemindersProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring Azure Table Storage reminders in an Orleans silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use Azure Table Storage for reminders, setting options based on provided configuration section.
